notes: Recipe of the W1 predictor zoo (plan docs/plans/2026-10-09-data-windows.md, 'Zoo grid'): 5 models x 4 losses x 2 regimes, plus two baselines in the same regimes, every lane scored on the same W1 walk-forward by PanelScore. Regime 'pooled' is one trunk and head over BTC and ETH with an asset indicator; 'per asset' is one lane per asset (so a pooled cell is one lane and its unpooled twin is two). `python -m crypto_trading.zoo_lanes configs/zoo-lanes-recipe.json --out configs/workflow-zoo-w1.json --w2-out configs/workflow-zoo-w2.json` writes the manifests; a test pins the shipped files to a fresh generation. Panel, window, folds, training, grid and zoo settings are inherited from `base` (the selection manifest), so the zoo and the selection cannot disagree on rows, folds or loss. Hyperparameters: children/index_options/configs/advanced-cdf-zoo.json (pooled PatchTST 64 wide, 3-component mixture, lr 3e-4, weight decay 0.01, patience 20) and run-pooled-zoo-417.json (GRU/LSTM, lr grid 3e-4..3e-3); the 1D-CNN is dskit's tcn arch with kernel 3 and dilations 1..16 (receptive field 63 >= the 60-bar window, refused at build otherwise). Run: `python -m dskit.pipeline workflow-batch configs/workflow-zoo-w1.json --root pipeline_runs/zoo-w1 --parallel 1` on ONE GPU lane at a time; `--only-lanes <lane>` for one cell. The zoo is not run until the owner approves epochs/stride/folds from the GPU probe.
args_notes: Inherited from the selection manifest (workflow-select-sequence.json) except `features`, `arms` (the lane names) and `cell` (each lane's full fit/score params, generated). `features.context` is the selected feature set: replace it with {"names": <selected-features-<class>.json columns>} (or overlay with --args) and regenerate; the default is every family, i.e. the selection's `all` arm.

features.notes: The selected feature set, as a ColumnSelector over the panel's summary columns (never the raw seq__ channels, which the sequence models read separately). Default = all families (the selection's `all` arm); the selection output fills it: {"names": [...]} from selected-features-<class>.json.

patchtst.notes: The options child's HF PatchTST (pooled, 64 wide); identical to the selection's encoder, pinned by a test.

cnn1d.notes: A causal 1D CNN: dskit's tcn arch; 1 + 2*(1+2+4+8+16) = 63 >= the 60-bar window.

gru.notes: A one-layer GRU; the options child's pooled GRU used 16 hidden, widened to the PatchTST's 64.

mlp.notes: Context-only: the trunk is the whole model (no sequence, no encoder); with the mixture head it is the options child's mixture MLP.

transformer.notes: The vanilla transformer encoder (dskit torch_ts arch; the options child's NeuralForecast VanillaTransformer is not installed here and takes one channel), 64 wide, 1 head as in advanced-cdf-zoo.json.

pinball.head: quantile
pinball.notes: Quantile head on the pinball loss at the grid's levels.

crps_tail.head: mixture
crps_tail.notes: CRPS plus tail CRPS: the selection's loss, weights read from training.losses.

empirical.notes: The vol-standardised empirical distribution of the fit band.

ewma_student.notes: A Student-t whose scale is a fitted multiple of the 60-minute-half-life EWMA volatility column; degrees chosen on the fit band.

w2.notes: The single W2 read. Bounds are fixed instants (plan: W2 is 2026-05-02 to 2026-08-01, the 1-day embargo day 2026-05-01 dropped; train_end is the last millisecond of W1); a test pins them to the plan. Finalists are frozen W1 lanes; with none chosen the manifest holds one unfilled lane that `workflow --plan` reports.
